name: wds_vtab-caltech101
description: An image-classification dataset derived from Caltech101 used in VTAB-style transfer and representation evaluation; it measures models' ability to adapt pre-trained representations to object-class recognition across 101 categories. Typically used to benchmark transfer learning / few-shot adaptation of visual encoders.
reputation: Widely used as part of VTAB/CLIP-style transfer benchmarks for assessing visual representation adaptation.
